Manufacturer promotion.

Stanley folding saw horses provide robust and portable work support for various trade applications. The saw horses are ideal for carpenters, builders, and general contractors requiring a stable platform on job sites or in workshops. Constructed with strong metal legs and a durable plastic body, they offer a substantial 340kg load capacity per pair, to ensure reliable support for heavy materials and equipment. The 109cm working width accommodates large workpieces, while rubberised feet enhance stability and protect surfaces. The folding design offers easy set-up, and includes a carry handle and shoulder strap, making transport and storage effortless.
